Next set is yours

We are surfing obsessed, and we invite you to join us.

The lodge sits in the green of the jungle. We run surf weeks for three levels, from your first wave to carving, and a Freestylers package for independent travellers.

Level 1 – Fomies

Level 1 – Fomies is for your first time on a board, no surfing experience needed. You learn on soft boards, on easy reef breaks and the sandy beaches around the lodge.

Included: 7 nights, 7 breakfasts, 5 dinners, 5 guided 2-hour surf sessions, 5 theory lessons, all equipment, transport to the spots, an excursion

Level 2 – Rollers

Level 2 – Rollers is for when you can stand up, but paddling out to the line-up and catching green waves is still a struggle. You surf easy reefs and beach breaks with deep-water channels, on soft boards.

Included: 7 nights, 7 breakfasts, 5 dinners, 5 guided 2-hour surf sessions, 5 theory lessons, all equipment, transport to the spots, an excursion

Level 3 – Riders

One price, three levels

The three surf weeks cost the same, per person for seven nights. That is the base price the booking engine showed on 28 September 2026. The room you choose can add to it; the engine shows any supplement once you pick your dates.

Packages start on a Saturday and run for 7, 14, 21 or 28 nights, for up to six guests per booking. Drinking water and local coffee and tea are unlimited.

Footwear is discouraged. Chilling out is inescapable.

Surf, breakfast, surf again

Head out with your group for a morning surf. Back at the lodge, a big, healthy breakfast is waiting.

After that the day is yours: relax at the lodge, or go out and explore before the afternoon surf. The evening ends with dinner, together with the other guests.

Twelve rooms, one big family

There are just twelve rooms. That keeps a stay here personal, part of one big happy family. Every room has air conditioning, a ceiling fan, a safe box, a private toilet and shower, a socket next to each bed and, of course, a board rack.

When you're not on the water, lie out on a sunbed by the pool under the palms, hang out in the common area, take an ice-cold drink from the bar, or eat Sri Lankan produce from the lodge kitchen.

Getting here

Booking.com puts Kathaluwa West Beach 40 m from the lodge and Kabalana Beach 350 m. Kathaluwa station is 400 m away, Ahangama Beach 4 km and Koggala Airport 3.9 km.
